panels.title: Per-Call Cost Details
panels.description: Turn-level cost breakdown. Each data point = one Claude response turn. cost_usd is retail API-equivalent at Anthropic's published rates.

panels.title: Avg Cost per Turn
panels.description: Average retail-API cost per Claude response turn across the selected range. Divide by session count to estimate avg cost per turn per session.

targets.expr: avg(avg_over_time({app="claude-token-metrics"} | json | __error__="" | model=~"$model" | project=~"$project" | effort=~"$effort" | unwrap cost_usd [$__range]))

panels.title: Most Expensive Single Turn
panels.description: Highest cost for any single Claude response turn in the selected time range. Spikes here indicate heavy tool use or large context turns.

targets.expr: max(max_over_time({app="claude-token-metrics"} | json | __error__="" | model=~"$model" | project=~"$project" | effort=~"$effort" | unwrap cost_usd [$__interval]))

panels.title: Daily Spend Rate
panels.description: API-equivalent retail spend rate extrapolated to a full 24 hours at current usage pace. Compare to your plan's daily budget (plan cost Ã· 30) to see if you're on track.

targets.expr: sum(rate({app="claude-token-metrics"} | json | __error__="" | model=~"$model" | project=~"$project" | effort=~"$effort" | unwrap cost_usd [$__range])) * 86400

panels.title: Turn Count
panels.description: Total number of Claude response turns (stop events) in the selected time range. Each turn = one Claude reply.

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({app="claude-token-metrics"} | json | __error__="" | model=~"$model" | project=~"$project" | effort=~"$effort" [$__range]))

panels.title: Per-Turn Cost Over Time
panels.description: API-equivalent cost per time interval. Each bar/point aggregates all turns in that bucket. Spikes = expensive turns (large context, heavy tool use). Flat = efficient steady-state work.

targets.expr: sum(sum_over_time({app="claude-token-metrics"} | json | __error__="" | model=~"$model" | project=~"$project" | effort=~"$effort" | unwrap cost_usd [$__interval]))

panels.title: P50 Median Cost
panels.description: Median per-turn cost. Half your turns cost less than this.

targets.expr: quantile_over_time(0.5, {app="claude-token-metrics"} | json | __error__="" | model=~"$model" | project=~"$project" | effort=~"$effort" | unwrap cost_usd [$__range])

panels.title: P90 Turn Cost
panels.description: 90th percentile. 10% of turns cost more than this.

targets.expr: quantile_over_time(0.9, {app="claude-token-metrics"} | json | __error__="" | model=~"$model" | project=~"$project" | effort=~"$effort" | unwrap cost_usd [$__range])

panels.title: P99 Turn Cost
panels.description: 99th percentile â€” tail cost. Agentic runaway turns show up here.

targets.expr: quantile_over_time(0.99, {app="claude-token-metrics"} | json | __error__="" | model=~"$model" | project=~"$project" | effort=~"$effort" | unwrap cost_usd [$__range])

panels.title: Burn Rate â€” $/hr & Tokens/min
panels.description: How fast you are spending at API-equivalent rates. Rate queries average over the selected time window.

panels.title: Avg $/hour
panels.description: Average API-equivalent spending rate per hour. rate(cost_usd) * 3600 over selected range.

targets.expr: sum(rate({app="claude-token-metrics"} | json | __error__="" | model=~"$model" | project=~"$project" | effort=~"$effort" | unwrap cost_usd [$__range])) * 3600

panels.title: Avg $/minute
panels.description: Average API-equivalent spending rate per minute. rate(cost_usd) * 60 over selected range.

targets.expr: sum(rate({app="claude-token-metrics"} | json | __error__="" | model=~"$model" | project=~"$project" | effort=~"$effort" | unwrap cost_usd [$__range])) * 60

panels.title: Output Tokens/min
panels.description: Average output token generation rate per minute across the selected range.

targets.expr: sum(rate({app="claude-token-metrics"} | json | __error__="" | model=~"$model" | project=~"$project" | effort=~"$effort" | unwrap total_output_tokens [$__range])) * 60

panels.title: Total Tokens/min
panels.description: Combined input + output token rate per minute. Proxy for active context consumption rate.

targets.expr: sum(rate({app="claude-token-metrics"} | json | __error__="" | model=~"$model" | project=~"$project" | effort=~"$effort" | unwrap total_input_tokens [$__range])) * 60
sum(rate({app="claude-token-metrics"} | json | __error__="" | model=~"$model" | project=~"$project" | effort=~"$effort" | unwrap total_output_tokens [$__range])) * 60

panels.title: Cost Rate Over Time ($/hr)
panels.description: Rolling hourly cost rate. Each bar = API-equivalent cost rate at that interval. Spikes = heavy sessions.

targets.expr: sum(rate({app="claude-token-metrics"} | json | __error__="" | model=~"$model" | project=~"$project" | effort=~"$effort" | unwrap cost_usd [$__interval])) * 3600

panels.title: Avg Tool Time vs Token Cost by Effort
panels.description: Compare tool overhead (wall time in tools) vs token cost per turn. Tool-bound turns have high tool_time_ms but lower cost_usd per token. Model-bound turns are the inverse.

targets.expr: avg by (effort) (avg_over_time({app="claude-token-metrics"} | json | __error__="" | model=~"$model" | project=~"$project" | effort=~"$effort" | tool_time_ms != "" | unwrap tool_time_ms [$__interval]))
avg by (effort) (avg_over_time({app="claude-token-metrics"} | json | __error__="" | model=~"$model" | project=~"$project" | effort=~"$effort" | unwrap cost_usd [$__interval])) * 1000

panels.title: Cache Read Tokens — Daily
panels.description: Tokens served from cache per day. Cache reads cost ~10x less than generating new tokens. This is your compute avoided — not expressed in dollars because the saving depends on model pricing.

targets.expr: sum(sum_over_time({app="claude-token-metrics"} | json | __error__="" | model=~"$model" | project=~"$project" | effort=~"$effort" | unwrap total_cache_read_tokens [$__interval]))

panels.title: Avg Cost: Thinking On vs Off
panels.description: Thinking mode uses extended computation tokens. This shows the average per-turn cost difference.

targets.expr: avg(avg_over_time({app="claude-token-metrics"} | json | __error__="" | model=~"$model" | project=~"$project" | effort=~"$effort" | thinking="true" | unwrap cost_usd [$__range]))
avg(avg_over_time({app="claude-token-metrics"} | json | __error__="" | model=~"$model" | project=~"$project" | effort=~"$effort" | thinking="false" | unwrap cost_usd [$__range]))

panels.title: Avg Turn Cost by Session Type
panels.description: Are resumed or compacted sessions more efficient than fresh startups?

targets.expr: avg by (session_type) (avg_over_time({app="claude-token-metrics"} | json | __error__="" | model=~"$model" | project=~"$project" | effort=~"$effort" | unwrap cost_usd [$__range]))

panels.title: Tool Calls vs Cost per Turn
panels.description: Do turns with more tool calls cost more? Cross-reference tool_use_count with cost_usd per turn interval to see correlation.

targets.expr: avg(avg_over_time({app="claude-token-metrics"} | json | __error__="" | model=~"$model" | project=~"$project" | effort=~"$effort" | unwrap tool_use_count [$__interval]))
avg(avg_over_time({app="claude-token-metrics"} | json | __error__="" | model=~"$model" | project=~"$project" | effort=~"$effort" | unwrap cost_usd [$__interval])) * 100
